reason: No distinct native bodily form: c11 permits invisible/amorphous presence, ordinary human/animal/haystack or light guises. c04/c05/c08 describe mental misdirection and wandering, not physically altered terrain or visible monster. An owl/person lure would read as ordinary animal/person, a floating light over bog as landscape with light; inventing distorted anatomy, duplicate illusions or a giant force would exceed documented visual traits. Declined before generation.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
artistic_choices: Decline rather than convert undocumented mental confusion into invented visible effects or creature anatomy.
